stories.summary: Opposition parties in Tamil Nadu are pressuring the administration regarding agrarian distress in the Cauvery delta. The DMK announced a consultation panel to hear farmer grievances, while the AMMK demanded the region be declared drought-hit. Both groups accused the government of ignoring water scarcity issues.

stories.title: Annamalai criticises state review on temple lighting
stories.summary: BJP leader K Annamalai urged the Tamil Nadu government to implement a Supreme Court order permitting the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at Thiruparankundram Hill. He questioned the state's decision to file a review petition against the court's November 20 verdict.

stories.title: Three convicted in Kannur murder case
stories.summary: A court in Kannur convicted three RSS activists for the 2016 murder of a CPI(M) worker who was stabbed 37 times. Sixteen other individuals were acquitted due to a lack of evidence. The verdict follows a long-running legal process regarding the political killing.

stories.title: Supreme Court mandates BS-VI vehicles in Delhi
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed that only BS-VI vehicles will be permitted in Delhi to address the winter pollution crisis. The court's intervention comes as the city continues to face severe air quality challenges. The mandate aims to restrict older, more polluting vehicles from operating.
